system.description: See your target and initiate a Mental Challenge (spend a Mental Trait first if the target is supernatural) to read her surface thoughts, send a brief mental message, or ask a truthful question. If unwilling, each question requires its own Mental Challenge. Spending an additional Mental Trait and winning a Static Mental Challenge against the target's Mental Traits (no relenting) lets you ask about Flaws, Negative Traits or derangements, potentially revealing artificial thoughts left by Dementation or Dominate.
